CZ Urges 1Password Users to Change All Passwords After Security Breach 1Password, a leading password management provider, disclosed a security breach in which attackers compromised an employee's corporate GitHub account, injected malicious code into backend systems and stole customer information, including names, email addresses, account identifiers and certain invitation and recovery tokens. Attackers also accessed private source code and the company's CI/CD system. 1Password said customer vaults, passwords and encryption keys remained secure, with no evidence of account takeovers. Binance founder CZ nevertheless urged users to change all their passwords, calling it "a pain in the neck, but necessary." — link

U.S. Bitcoin and Ether ETFs Shed $522 Million, Led by BlackRock According to SoSoValue, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $453 million in net outflows on November 25, led by BlackRock's IBIT with $330 million. Spot Ethereum ETFs saw $68.51 million in net outflows, with BlackRock's ETHA also recording $68.51 million in withdrawals. — link

21Shares Warns Bitcoin Could Fall to $53,250 as Stablecoin Supply Sees Sharpest Drop Since Terra Collapse Crypto asset manager 21Shares said in a November 24 report that the Binance hack merely triggered Bitcoin's recent selloff, while capital outflows and leveraged liquidations drove most of the losses. Stablecoin supply fell $10.7 billion following the attack, marking the largest 18-day decline in dollar terms since the Terra collapse in 2022. The firm warned that rallies may struggle to hold until stablecoin supply and spot ETF inflows recover. It identified Bitcoin's realized price of $53,250 as a key downside level, with deeper declines to $37,200–$43,800 possible under historical bear-market scenarios, though it considers such outcomes unlikely. — link
